mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corpGr , t1.TR_YMD AS trYmd , t1.TR_CD AS trCd , t1.FUND_CD AS fundCd , ia.FUND_NM AS fundNm , t1.JM_CD AS jmCd , t1.KRAK_YMD AS krakYmd , t1.BALH_CO AS balhCo , t1.BALH_GA AS balhGa , t1.TR_JUSU AS trJusu , t1.TR_DANGA AS trDanga , t1.TR_AEK AS trAek , t1.SUSU AS susu , t1.GYUL_AEK AS gyulAek , t1.TR_CO_CD AS trCoCd , t1.CHENG_YMD AS chengYmd , t1.TYPE_TRENCH AS typeTrench , t1.BS_TYPE AS bsType , 1 AS pVisible FROM SJT5J1 t1 JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = #{trYmd} AND t1.TR_CD = #{trCd} AND t1.JM_CD = #{jmCd} ORDER BY t1.TR_YMD ASC, t1.TR_CD ASC, t1.FUND_CD ASC
